text:
maria: Mockups for a compact 'Latency explorer' view are up — focusing on p95 overlay + heatmap scrubber. PTAL: keyboard nav, time presets, and the sampling toggle copy. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc (see notes).

raj: Nice direction. Two quick things: p95 line on dark mode has low contrast, and the hover tooltip currently obscures the scrubber knob. Can we move the tooltip above the scrubber?

sam: a11y nits: p95 should have an accessible name/role and a visible focus ring when keyboard-focused. Also time preset chips need explicit `aria-pressed` states.

ben: Copy nit on the sampling control — 'Sampling: adaptive' feels vague. Suggest something clearer like 'Sampling: Auto (reduces detail to keep charts snappy)'.

maria: Agree on clearer copy. Leaning toward shorter microcopy: 'Auto sample to preserve performance'. For color contrast, propose tokenizing p95 color so we can swap for themes. Quick CSS sketch: ```css
:root {
  --redwood-p95: #b02a3b;
  --redwood-p95-contrast: #ffffff;
}
.chart .p95 {
  stroke: var(--redwood-p95);
}
```
We'll pick a version that meets 4.5:1.

raj: I'll try a darker #8b1f28 and update the token. Also propose a subtle interaction: when user drags the scrubber, the heatmap should enter a temporary 'live sample' mode (lower density) to avoid frame drops.

ella: UX caveat — auto switching to 'live sample' might surprise users. Recommend a small inline microcopy next to the toggle: 'Live sampling active — higher refresh rate, lower fidelity' and show a transient 2s toast when mode engages.

sam: Also request keyboard shortcuts: support `<` and `>` to nudge the time window by 10%. And ensure screen reader announces metric value like 'p95: 12 milliseconds' when focus lands on the p95 point.

ben: For the metrics table under the chart, add an explicit 'unit' column (ms / rps) and a small affordance to pin percentiles (pin icon). That will reduce confusion for new users.

maria: I updated the Figma with the copy changes, contrast token, and the tiny toast/tooltip behaviors. Note on presets: prefer readable labels like 'Last 15 minutes' instead of shortened '15m' — clearer for novices. Pinged @raj for an implementation PR.

raj: I'll open the PR tonight. Plan: add aria attributes, move tooltip placement above scrubber, implement the token swap for themes, and add screenshot tests for keyboard flows. @deploy-bot can you kick staging once PR is up?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging build queued for branch 'latency-compact'. CI: running 4/7 checks.

raj: CI green for storybook snapshots. I'll add the screenshot tests and a small e2e for keyboard nav.

ben: :thumbsup: After QA let's do a 10–15 minute usability session with 3 folks to validate the microcopy and live-sample behavior.

maria: Thanks all — leaving a couple inline comments in Figma. Will follow up on the session scheduling.
